statement: After the existing owner has durably completed a priority ADD, entity-scoped priority-recovery observation cannot downgrade that operation to an older CREATING row; it preserves terminal authority or explicitly defers, allowing the existing surplus REMOVE and fresh-formation ready-lease paths to converge.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

This Quest is the mandatory successor to rolling-restart-fresh-formation-terminal-add-observation after that Quest emitted a new-quest-only attempt-integrity violation. Treat no rejected predecessor attempt as accepted source evidence; remeasure the complete candidate through the committed shared guard-test scenario adapter.

The exact terminal-ADD downgrade must remain reproduced through the real ReplicaOperationRepository and control-plane gateway authority contract: confirm the terminal transition, make the later owner-RPC path unavailable while an older SQL CREATING row is visible, and prove the fixed observation preserves terminal state or returns a typed deferral. Preserve the red-on-revert receipt.

Reuse the existing owner-RPC authority modes, owner-persisted transition witness, terminal-transition repair, complete_priority_recovery_drain action, priority planner, surplus-remove safety, and shared guard-test scenario runner. Do not add an operation owner, cache, watermark store, timer, retry loop, readiness path, formation path, or alternate harness.

Once the owning persistence path has confirmed a terminal operation version, a later entity-scoped observation used for recovery planning must not expose an older nonterminal version as authoritative. Owner unavailability, empty reads, conflicting identity, or uncertain authority must defer fail-closed rather than infer terminality, absence, or safe removal.

Preserve the current priority ADD completion semantics and existing surplus REMOVE safety checks. The correction must only prevent stale nonterminal re-entry; it must not force completion, synthesize a REMOVE, bypass voter-ready membership safety, or treat physical replica ACTIVE as durable workflow completion.

Fresh formation must remain fail-closed on genuinely nonterminal operations and unsafe placement, while the landed durable-rejoin cold-formation exemption remains unchanged. Unknown authority must not release the ready lease, and shutdown/cache-only diagnostics must not reopen remote reads.

Do not widen the 120-second formation or restart budgets, lower workload, weaken canonical membership or ready-lease checks, alter statistical bars, or add planner wakeups to mask the repeated CREATING observation.

The focused TLA+ model must prove terminal observation monotonicity, typed owner-unavailable deferral, eventual reuse of surplus REMOVE, and a stale-SQL counterexample. The existing architecture contract and Alloy gates must remain green; do not extend Alloy because ownership and membership cardinality are unchanged.

After deterministic, adjacent, model, and independent verification closure on one exact clean commit, run at most one unchanged N=1 rolling-restart diagnostic. Do not spend another N=15 certification window in this child Quest; return any later blocker with exact mechanism evidence to the representative parent.
